newsitem.title: USA: US mortgage-backeds flat, spreads narrow to Treas.
newsitem.headline: US mortgage-backeds flat, spreads narrow to Treas.

text.p: U.S. mortgage-backed securities were mostly unchanged on Thursday, but spreads narrowed as jittery Treasuries traded lower, market experts said.
"We saw pretty good buying across the board today," an adjustable-rate mortgage (ARM) trader said. "There was a lot of interest in TBA product, 6.0- and 6.5-percent."
In pass-throughs, Ginnie Mae 30-year 7.5-percent coupons were unchanged at 99-9/32, yielding 96 basis points over the 10-year Treasury note.
Comparable Fannie Mae paper was up 1/32 at 99-9/32, and Freddie Mac issues were 1/32 at 99-14/32.
In late trading, the 10-year note was off 5/32 to yield 6.75 percent.
